Here's the situation: 44-year-old competitive masters CrossFit athlete, 14 weeks post arthroscopic supraspinatus repair. Full active ROM, zero pain across three weeks of empty-barbell drills. Surgeon cleared me to advance overhead loading based on functional tolerance at my 12-week checkup. My CSCS head coach reviewed and praised this 4-week ramp I built:

Weeks 15-18: overhead work 3x/week
- Snatch complexes + push presses
- Progressing 3x3 at 70% current post-op 1RM up to 5x5 by week 4
- Deload week 4

I need to upload this to my athlete management platform tonight to lock in my non-refundable $350 qualifier registration. Is this loading scheme sound?
